metadata.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
metadata.description: Terminal coding-agent reference that requires a GitHub Copilot entitlement and is governed by GitHub's restricted Copilot CLI license.
metadata.provenance: Official repository, current non-archived project status, README prerequisites, LICENSE.md and current GitHub Copilot plan availability reviewed on 2026-09-10 for #638. The upstream license permits install/run and limited redistribution of unmodified copies but explicitly withholds modification/derivative-work rights. Copilot CLI is available on the limited free Copilot tier as well as paid tiers, so cost is conditional rather than inherently incompatible. Authenticated GitHub/Copilot access remains required. No third-party executable code is bundled by this catalog.
metadata.changelog: Catalog record v1; active upstream classified deferred for restricted-license/hosted-provider review. A limited free Copilot tier includes CLI access, while expanded usage may require paid capacity.

metadata.name: Claude Code
metadata.description: Terminal coding-agent reference governed by Anthropic commercial terms rather than an open-source software license.
metadata.provenance: Official repository, current non-archived project status and LICENSE.md reviewed on 2026-09-10 for #638. The repository license states all rights reserved and makes use subject to Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service. Current official consumer guidance requires a paid Pro or Max subscription for Claude Code access; API use is separately billed. No third-party executable code is bundled by this catalog.
metadata.changelog: Catalog record v1; active upstream classified deferred because Anthropic paid-service dependency conflicts with the project's no-additional-paid-AI-services policy.

metadata.name: Multica
metadata.description: Self-hostable agent-team platform candidate with a modified Apache-based license containing hosted-service, branding and attribution conditions.
metadata.provenance: Official repository, current non-archived project status and complete Multica LICENSE reviewed on 2026-09-10 for #638. The license incorporates Apache-2.0 but adds restrictions for hosted/embedded third-party services without a commercial license plus branding and attribution conditions. Internal use within one organization is explicitly allowed without a commercial license. No third-party executable code is bundled by this catalog.
metadata.changelog: Catalog record v1; retained as an evaluation candidate only with explicit modified-license and conditional-cost metadata rather than normalized to plain Apache-2.0.

metadata.name: GSD

metadata.provenance: Official repository identity, MIT license and GitHub archived status verified on 2026-09-10 for #638. The archived upstream is retained only as historical/reference material; no fork is silently substituted. No third-party executable code is bundled by this catalog.
metadata.changelog: Catalog record v1; archived upstream classified as reference-only.

metadata.name: MuSViT
metadata.description: Sheet-music foundation vision model reference deferred from general platform adoption because its official code is licensed for non-commercial use.
metadata.provenance: Official ECCV 2026 repository, current non-archived status and README license/runtime requirements reviewed on 2026-09-10 for #638. The README states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and documents GPU-required experiment paths plus Hugging Face and Weights & Biases authentication. No third-party executable code or model weights are bundled by this catalog.
metadata.changelog: Catalog record v1; classified deferred for general adoption because the official work is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while GPU/provider requirements remain visible for reference.
